fixes: Use streaming for the main agent without changing the provider/model/reasoning configuration. Normalize missing assistant roles before chunk aggregation and persist complete AI messages so tool calls are not dropped.
Reject aborted partial responses. Share bilingual timeout errors and preserve resumed input/intermediate tool results even when the outer stream exits with an exception.

Project repeated code-check feedback into reversible groups for LLM context only; saved source results remain intact. Record request size, elapsed time, usage and error codes without putting secrets in run events.

Make repeated removal of a declared, already-absent draft leaf idempotent on an existing stable-ID object. Unknown fields, absent/ambiguous IDs, protected fields and atomic batch validation remain enforced.

Tell the agent to confirm missing design conditions before writing them, and to edit existing models rather than reconstructing drafts. Live acceptance asserts no material/member design fields before the explicit fourth input.
Allow 20 seconds for one adapter boundary test containing three protocol and two Python entry process starts. Physical assertions and numeric tolerances were not changed.

Persist only streams that emitted start. Rejected duplicate or stale clarification requests must not copy prior tools or modify conversation history. Both public streaming endpoints have regression counterexamples.

Remove the clarification tool instruction that always forced draft extraction, even after an existing model was built. Answers now direct current-model updates to query_model/edit_model; a missing or pending model still follows draft extraction. This resolves a conflict with the main system instruction, without changing engineering input values.

Align optional null node restraints and element rotation with the authoritative Python V2 schema. Do not coerce malformed strings or invent values. Test both fields through the real Python conversion without automatic repair.

When generic model correction is disabled or exhausted, preserve the original validation failure rather than replacing it with a recovery-budget error. The first attempt remains available and no extra model call is made.

Expose current-analysis validity and its reason in query/edit/undo responses, using the existing validity check. Explain that edited models require analysis before checks/reports. Explicitly document Math.js exponent syntax in the calculator argument.
